title: Blocked, Proprietary, Unknown, or Disputed Sources
description: Sources that must not be fetched, mirrored, packaged, or used by default because their rights are unknown, proprietary, disputed, or otherwise unsafe.
notes: Blocked sources may be documented only as disabled metadata when there is a clear reason to track them.
Blocked sources must not be downloaded, mirrored, packaged, or exposed as usable runtime sources.
